title: OMNIFIX
subtitle: Autonomous Multi-Agent Security Repair
description: A coordinated team of AI agents that detects vulnerabilities in Python code, writes exploits to prove impact, applies patches, and validates fixes — all in a closed-loop autonomous workflow with zero human intervention.
features: Security Auditor: Static analysis mapped to CWE vulnerability standards
Exploit Generator: Creates proof-of-concept exploits for real-world impact demonstration
Patch Architect: Generates secure, regression-free code patches
Patch Validator: Bandit static analysis ensures fix validity
Closed-loop execution: Repeats until code passes all security checks

title: EmailEnv
subtitle: AI Email Agent Simulation & Training Platform
description: A Streamlit-based interactive platform simulating how AI agents read, classify, and act on email streams — modeling sequential decision-making, rewards, and a hybrid fallback architecture for high-confidence processing.
features: Interactive Training Mode with Starter, Medium, and Advanced difficulty levels
Step-by-step email processing with live status updates and reward scoring
Hybrid AI System: Gemini API with instantaneous local fallback agent
Premium dark-theme UI built natively in Streamlit for optimal observability

title: QubitScope
subtitle: Interactive Quantum Bloch Sphere Simulator
description: An interactive quantum simulation tool that visualizes the real-time evolution of a single qubit on a 3D Bloch sphere — enabling users to apply quantum gates and inspect superposition and phase shifts directly in the browser.
features: Interactive 3D Bloch Sphere with real-time qubit state visualization
Live quantum gate transformations: X, Z, and Hadamard gates
Real-time measurement probability calculations
State representation in Dirac notation with complete gate history tracking

title: AirForge
subtitle: Gesture-Controlled Creative Workspace
description: A webcam-based gesture-controlled workspace where hand tracking maps complex gestures to 2D brush strokes and 3D voxel model construction — no plugins, no stylus, just your hands.
features: Ink Space: Neon glow drawing, freehand shapes, and gesture-based select/move
Build Space: Orbit controls, grid overlays, and 3D voxel placement
Computer Vision Hand Tracking: Pinch to draw, open palm to place or orbit camera
Canvas Export: High-resolution PNG outputs from both 2D and 3D scenes

title: DeepFocus
subtitle: Offline-First Cognitive Flow Workspace
description: A highly optimized browser workspace for cognitive flow using real-time Web Audio API procedural soundscapes synthesized entirely in-browser — no server calls, no accounts, completely private.
features: Auditory Studio & 5-Band Equalizer: Real-time synthesis of Zen Rain, Forest Wind, Coffee Murmur
Focus Engine: Automatic Pomodoro intervals with distraction-free fullscreen Zen mode
Local Analytics: SVG productivity charts powered by IndexedDB behavioral tracking
Privacy First: Zero server calls — runs fully client-side on any device
